rule: a source enters the research index only if its classification is 'public' or 'research-safe'; any other value, a missing entry or a source not listed here is rejected and the build fails. Presence in the inventory manifest does NOT admit a source.

classes.public: our own pipeline output already published in the public repo or Pages; no third-party text beyond titles
classes.research-safe: public repo content that carries third-party titles, excerpts (<= 360 chars) or extracted claims; admitted under the no-full-text rule
